name: Damp surveys
summary: Inspection, moisture readings and a clear written report with photos.
description: A thorough inspection to find out what's really causing the damp. We take moisture readings, check inside and out, and give you a clear written report with photos and plain-English recommendations.
signs: Damp patches, tidemarks or peeling paint
A musty smell that won't go away
Mould that keeps coming back
You're letting, buying or selling and want a clear picture

name: Rising damp and DPC
summary: Damp-proof course installation, including chemical DPC injection.
description: Rising damp happens when moisture from the ground soaks up through a wall because the damp-proof course (DPC) has failed, been bridged or was never there. Once we've confirmed it really is rising damp, we can install a new DPC, including chemical DPC injection.
signs: A tidemark low on the wall, usually up to about a metre
White, powdery salts on the wall surface
Rotting or stained skirting boards
Crumbling plaster near the floor

name: Penetrating damp
summary: Tracing and fixing water getting in through walls, roofs and openings.
description: Penetrating damp is water getting in from outside, through walls, roofs, windows, doors or leaking gutters. We trace where it's coming in and fix the cause, not just the stain.
signs: Damp patches that grow after heavy rain
Damp at any height, often on outside walls
Damp around windows, doors or chimneys
Cracked render or missing pointing outside

name: Condensation and mould
summary: Diagnosis, mould treatment and ventilation improvements.
description: Condensation is the most common cause of damp in UK homes. Moist air settles on cold surfaces and mould follows. We diagnose it, treat the mould, improve ventilation and give practical advice to stop it coming back.
signs: Black mould in corners, behind furniture or around windows
Windows streaming with water in the morning
Musty smells, especially in bedrooms and bathrooms
Problems that get worse in winter

name: Basement and cellar tanking
summary: Waterproofing below-ground rooms so they stay dry and usable.
description: Tanking waterproofs below-ground rooms so they stay dry, whether you want better storage or a room you can actually use. We assess the space and recommend the right approach for it.
signs: Damp or wet cellar walls
Puddles or standing water after rain
White salt deposits on brick or stone
A strong musty smell below ground

name: Timber treatment
summary: Treating woodworm, wet rot and dry rot.
description: We identify and treat woodworm, wet rot and dry rot, and deal with the damp that caused the rot in the first place, so the problem doesn't return.
signs: Small round holes and fine dust in timber
Soft, spongy or cracked wood
Fungal growth or white strands on timber or masonry
A damp, mushroom-like smell

name: Replastering
description: After damp treatment, walls often need replastering with the right materials so salts and moisture don't spoil the finish. We leave walls sound and ready to decorate.
signs: Plaster that sounds hollow or is coming away
Salt-stained plaster that won't hold paint
Walls that need making good after a new DPC

name: Exterior repairs
summary: Guttering, drainpipes, rendering, pointing and other above-ground repairs.
description: Many damp problems start outside. We carry out above-ground repairs, including damp-proof courses, drainpipes and guttering, rendering and pointing, to stop water getting in.
signs: Overflowing or leaking gutters and downpipes
Cracked, missing or crumbling pointing
Cracked or blown render
Soil or paving piled high against outside walls
